---
name: Feature Request / Epic
about: Propose a new feature or large initiative for this project
title: 'Epic: <short description of the feature>'
labels: epic, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A short, high-level description of the feature or epic.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits from it? Why is it important now?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the proposed feature, user experience, and any technical approach you have in mind.

## Goals & Success Metrics

- Goal 1: ...
- Goal 2: ...
- How will we measure success?

## Non-Goals

List anything explicitly out of scope for this feature.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe other approaches you have considered and why they were not chosen.

## Risks & Open Questions

- Risk 1: ...
- Open question 1: ...

## Additional Context

Add mockups, diagrams, links, or related issues to help maintainers understand the request.
